full_page.content:
1913
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 19 Cont.
June 30 Rev. P. B Bruno starts once more to say holy Mass, still in St. Francis Hospital.
June 30 Geo Kelly is awarded job of building our New Church.
Page 20 July 2nd Feast of Visitation - work of preparation begun on New Sacred Heart Church. Altar boys Special meeting.
13 Fr. Theodosius ordained
15 Fr. Bruno returned from Hosp'l.
20 First Mass Celebration - Fr. Theo'd. A good number of old servers & students served. Rt. Rev. Mons. Lings & R. Dr. Mulcahy were in Sanctuary. V. Rev. Antonine preached. Large number of friends took dinner at Mon- astery.
July 24 Feast of St. Fr. Solanus
24th Genett Kellog. aged 4 yrs received holy Communion first time - then daily. Fine rain To-day - answer to prayer - in case said First Communion might please God.
Aug. 2 Feast of Portiuncula - many holy Communions received - Solemn Mass at 8 o'cl well attend.
3 Rev. John F. Noll - Editor of Our Sund'y Visitor - visited our Monastery To-day.
4 Miss Lawrence started taking census.
Aug. 15th Beautiful Feast of Assumption
16th First week of retreat began. Fifteen Masses daily. The altar boys were reported as having done fairly well.
